templates.github_actions:
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  APP_ENV: ${{ vars.APP_ENV || 'staging' }}
  NODE_VERSION: '20'
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.11'

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      {{BUILD_STEPS}}

  quality:
    name: Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      {{QUALITY_STEPS}}

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: quality
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      {{TEST_STEPS}}

  deploy:
    name: Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      {{AUTH_STEPS}}
      {{DEPLOY_STEPS}}

  alert:
    name: Notify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy
    if: always()
    steps:
      {{ALERT_STEPS}}

  rollback:
    name: Rollback
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [deploy, alert]
    if: failure()
    steps:
      {{ROLLBACK_STEPS}}
templates.gitlab_ci:
stages:
  - build
  - quality
  - test
  - deploy

variables:
  APP_ENV: ${APP_ENV:-staging}
  NODE_VERSION: "20"
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11"

build:
  stage: build
  {{BUILD_STEPS}}

quality:
  stage: quality
  {{QUALITY_STEPS}}

test:
  stage: test
  {{TEST_STEPS}}

deploy:
  stage: deploy
  only:
    - main
  id_tokens:
    GITLAB_OIDC_TOKEN:
      aud: https://gitlab.com
  script:
    {{AUTH_STEPS}}
    {{DEPLOY_STEPS}}
  after_script:
    - echo "Deploy job result: ${CI_JOB_STATUS}"
    - |
      if [ "${CI_JOB_STATUS}" = "failed" ]; then
        echo "[ROLLBACK] Deploy failed - initiating recovery..."
        {{ROLLBACK_STEPS}}
      fi
    - |
      echo "[ALERT] Sending notifications..."
      {{ALERT_STEPS}}

  - name: npm_config_cache
    value: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/.npm

pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest

stages:
  - stage: Build
    displayName: Build Stage
    jobs:
      - job: BuildJob
        displayName: Build
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          {{BUILD_STEPS}}

  - stage: Quality
    displayName: Code Quality Stage
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - job: QualityJob
        displayName: Lint & Analyze
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          {{QUALITY_STEPS}}

  - stage: Test
    displayName: Test Stage
    dependsOn: Quality
    jobs:
      - job: TestJob
        displayName: Run Tests
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          {{TEST_STEPS}}

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: Deploy Stage
    dependsOn: Test
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
    jobs:
      - job: DeployJob
        displayName: Deploy
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          {{AUTH_STEPS}}
          {{DEPLOY_STEPS}}

  - stage: Alert
    displayName: Notification Stage
    dependsOn: Deploy
    condition: always()
    jobs:
      - job: AlertJob
        displayName: Send Alerts
        steps:
          {{ALERT_STEPS}}

  - stage: Rollback
    displayName: Rollback Stage
    dependsOn: Deploy
    condition: failed()
    jobs:
      - job: RollbackJob
        displayName: Rollback
        steps:
          {{ROLLBACK_STEPS}}

        run: |
          echo "Checking deployment health..."
          DEPLOY_OK=true
          if [ -n "${{ env.KUBE_NAMESPACE }}" ]; then
            FAILED_PODS=$(kubectl get pods -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default} -l app=${KUBE_APP_LABEL} --field-selector=status.phase!=Running -o name 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
            if [ "$FAILED_PODS" -gt 0 ]; then
              echo "Detected $FAILED_PODS non-running pods"
              DEPLOY_OK=false
            fi
          fi
          echo "deploy_healthy=$DEPLOY_OK" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
      - name: Rollback Kubernetes Deployment
        if: steps.failure_check.outputs.deploy_healthy == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "[ROLLBACK] Initiating automated rollback..."
          for deployment in $(kubectl get deployments -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default} -l app=${KUBE_APP_LABEL} -o name); do
            echo "Rolling back: $deployment"
            kubectl rollout undo $deployment -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default}
            kubectl rollout status $deployment -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default} --timeout=300s
            echo "Current revision: $(kubectl rollout history $deployment -n ${KUBE_NAMESPACE:-default} | tail -1)"
          done
          echo "[ROLLBACK] Rollback completed."
      - name: Rollback EC2 Deployment
        if: steps.failure_check.outputs.deploy_healthy == 'false' && env.EC2_HOST != ''

            docker compose pull || true
            docker compose up -d --force-recreate
            sleep 10
            docker compose ps
          ROLLBACK_EOF
          echo "[ROLLBACK] EC2 rollback completed."
